description.en:
SA01 is ENGINEAI's extensible bipedal robot platform for developing and studying legged movement. Its 12-degree-of-freedom architecture concentrates on the lower-body platform, providing a basis for gait-control experiments and integration with additional hardware. ENGINEAI identifies its own S160 motors and a 15 Ah lithium battery as core components.

The manufacturer provides operating instructions and demonstration material through a dedicated support page. SA01 should be evaluated as a development platform: its configuration and locomotion focus differ from ENGINEAI's complete upper-body humanoids such as SE01 and PM01.
